summary_en:
Shravani, located in Madhapur, requested general servicing for her split AC and asked for a technician at 10:00 AM the following morning. She provided her email address. The agent stated that the appointment was confirmed and created in the system/calendar, but said a calendar invite could not be sent by email. The quoted service price was ₹599. Shravani then asked the agent to verify that the appointment was genuinely confirmed and recorded; the agent reaffirmed that it was confirmed and that the calendar event had been created. She expressed satisfaction, said she needed nothing else, and ended the call.

Server check: no confirmed order was recorded for this call, so it was not marked as converted.
